modalities.evidence: 632 breast-MRI imaging sessions acquired on a 1.5T MR system
collected for 200 patients from clinical notes

output.population: Patients undergoing breast MRI at a single institution between 2018-2021; supporting data collected for 200 patients
output.summary: Single-institution retrospective collection of 632 breast MRI sessions from 2018-2021, including standard dynamic contrast-enhanced and delayed contrast series plus treatment response assessment maps, with supporting clinical and pathology data for 200 patients.
